list.name: Scraper failures
list.rawSql:
SELECT started_at AS time,
       COALESCE(finished_at, started_at + INTERVAL '15 minutes') AS time_end,
       COALESCE(NULLIF(left(error, 160), ''), 'run failed') AS text
FROM scrape_runs
WHERE status = 'error'
  AND $__timeFilter(started_at)

description: What is on the market right now: supply, asking prices, fresh listings and price drops — for the current filter selection.

panels.title: Active listings
panels.description: Seen by a scrape in the last 14 days and not closed. Respects every filter.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS active
FROM listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
WHERE room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])

panels.title: New · 7 d
panels.description: Active listings first seen in the last week — fresh supply.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS new7
FROM listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
WHERE room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])
  AND l.first_seen > now() - INTERVAL '7 days'

panels.title: Price drops · 7 d
panels.description: Distinct active listings whose observed price fell at least once this week.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT pc.article_id) AS dropped
FROM v_listing_price_changes pc
JOIN listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], NULLIF('${min_sqm}', '')::numeric, NULLIF('${max_sqm}', '')::numeric, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}], false) l
  ON l.article_id = pc.article_id
WHERE pc.delta < 0
  AND pc.effective_at > now() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND pc.deal = ANY (ARRAY(SELECT CASE WHEN selected = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE selected END FROM unnest(ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]) AS t(selected)))

  AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])

panels.title: Median KM/m² · sales
panels.description: Median asking price per m² across sale listings matching the filters (implausible parses excluded).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.ppm2)
FROM listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
WHERE l.ppm2 > 0
  AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])

panels.title: Median rent · KM/mo
panels.description: Median monthly asking rent among rental listings matching the filters.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.price)
FROM listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
WHERE l.is_rent AND l.price > 0
  AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])

panels.title: Median asking KM/m² — daily snapshots, with p25–p75 band
panels.description: Pooled reconstructed daily inventory asking prices for the selected period. Percentiles are NULL when no eligible priced rows exist; sample, estimated, stale and provisional columns expose data quality.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo' AS time,
       p25 AS "p25 KM/m2",
       median AS "median KM/m2",
       p75 AS "p75 KM/m2",
       inventory_count AS "inventory",
       priced_count AS "priced sample",
       estimated_count AS "estimated",
       stale_count AS "stale",
       provisional_day AS "provisional"
FROM market_daily_filtered(
  date($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo'),
  date($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo'),
  ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}],
  NULLIF('${min_sqm}', '')::numeric,
  NULLIF('${max_sqm}', '')::numeric,
  ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}],
  ARRAY(SELECT CASE WHEN selected = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE selected END FROM unnest(ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]) AS t(selected)),
  ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}])
ORDER BY day

panels.title: Active sale listings by rooms
panels.description: Sale side of the current filter selection.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT room_bucket(l.rooms) AS bucket, count(*) AS listings
FROM listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], NULLIF('${min_sqm}', '')::numeric, NULLIF('${max_sqm}', '')::numeric, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
WHERE NOT l.is_rent
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])

  AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
  
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Inventory flow — new vs closed per day · all categories
panels.description: All categories and deals. New counts each article once on its first discovery date; repeated sightings and renewals are not additions. Closed and reopened count lifecycle events. Active inventory is reconstructed and may include inferred or stale observations; today is provisional.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo' AS time,
       new_n AS "new", closed_n AS "closed", reopened_n AS "reopened",
       active_est AS "active (est)", stale_n AS "stale", provisional_day AS "provisional"
FROM v_market_daily
WHERE day BETWEEN date($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')
              AND date($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')
ORDER BY day

panels.title: Stalest active listings — oldest creation day first
panels.description: Age measured from the ad's creation day (olx publish date; falls back to our first sighting). renewed_day is the seller's last bump — NULL until the renewal backfill converges; an old renewed_day means the ad has stopped competing for attention.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT l.title, l.url, l.price, l.ppm2,
       COALESCE(l.published_at, l.first_seen)::date AS created_day,
       l.renewed_at::date AS renewed_day,
       round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - COALESCE(l.published_at, l.first_seen))) / 86400.0)::int AS days_online
FROM listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
WHERE room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])
ORDER BY COALESCE(l.published_at, l.first_seen) ASC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Listing map — click a pin to open the ad
panels.description: Pins of active listings placed by their ad's map coordinates; respects every filter.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT l.latitude, l.longitude, l.title, l.url,
       l.price, l.sqm, l.rooms, l.ppm2,
       l.location AS location
FROM listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
WHERE l.latitude IS NOT NULL AND l.longitude IS NOT NULL
  AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])

panels.title: Pinned listings on map — click title to open
panels.description: The 100 most recently seen pinned listings — companion table to the map. Click a title to open the ad on olx.ba.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT l.title, l.url, l.price, l.sqm, l.rooms, l.ppm2, l.latitude, l.longitude
FROM listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
WHERE l.latitude IS NOT NULL AND l.longitude IS NOT NULL
  AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])
ORDER BY l.last_seen DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Best value — lowest KM/m² (sales)
panels.description: Cheapest per m² among sale listings matching the filters.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT l.title, l.url, l.location, l.rooms, l.sqm, l.price, l.ppm2
FROM listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
WHERE NOT l.is_rent AND l.ppm2 > 0
  AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])
ORDER BY l.ppm2 ASC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Recent price drops — newest first
panels.description: Every observed price decrease in full history window (scans all snapshots).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT l.title, l.url, pc.prior_price AS was, pc.price AS now,
       (pc.prior_price - pc.price) AS drop, pc.effective_at AS seen
FROM v_listing_price_changes pc
JOIN listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], NULLIF('${min_sqm}', '')::numeric, NULLIF('${max_sqm}', '')::numeric, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}], false) l
  ON l.article_id = pc.article_id
WHERE pc.delta < 0
  AND pc.deal = ANY (ARRAY(SELECT CASE WHEN selected = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE selected END FROM unnest(ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]) AS t(selected)))

  AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])
ORDER BY pc.effective_at DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Actives that cut their price
panels.description: Active listings whose history contains at least one observed decrease — negotiation leverage exists here.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cuts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pc.article_id
  FROM v_listing_price_changes pc
  WHERE pc.delta < 0 AND pc.deal = ANY (ARRAY(SELECT CASE WHEN selected = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE selected END FROM unnest(ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]) AS t(selected)))
)
SELECT count(*)::text
FROM cuts c
JOIN listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], NULLIF('${min_sqm}', '')::numeric, NULLIF('${max_sqm}', '')::numeric, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}], false) l
  ON l.article_id = c.article_id
WHERE TRUE

  AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])

panels.title: Median biggest cut · KM
panels.description: Median of the largest single cut per cutting listing.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cuts AS (
  SELECT pc.article_id, max(-pc.delta) AS biggest
  FROM v_listing_price_changes pc
  WHERE pc.delta < 0 AND pc.deal = ANY (ARRAY(SELECT CASE WHEN selected = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE selected END FROM unnest(ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]) AS t(selected)))
  GROUP BY pc.article_id
)
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.biggest)
FROM cuts c
JOIN listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], NULLIF('${min_sqm}', '')::numeric, NULLIF('${max_sqm}', '')::numeric, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}], false) l
  ON l.article_id = c.article_id
WHERE TRUE

  AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])

panels.title: Median KM/m² by rooms · sales
panels.description: Asking-price segmentation by size — watch the spread between buckets.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT room_bucket(l.rooms) AS bucket,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.ppm2)::int AS median_ppm2
FROM listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
WHERE NOT l.is_rent AND l.ppm2 > 0 AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Asking KM/m² by condition · sales
panels.description: Detail-page condition labels (min. 5 listings). Does Novogradnja actually command a premium?

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(l.condition, ''), '(unknown)') AS bucket,
       count(*) AS n,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.ppm2)::int AS median_ppm2
FROM listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
WHERE NOT l.is_rent AND l.condition IS NOT NULL AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])
GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) >= 5 ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Most viewed active listings
panels.description: Pregledi counter from ad pages — what everyone else is watching (where exposed).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT l.title, l.url, l.views, l.sqm, l.rooms, l.price, l.ppm2
FROM listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
WHERE l.views IS NOT NULL AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]) AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])
ORDER BY l.views DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT CASE WHEN l.latitude IS NULL THEN '(no pin)'
            ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(l.location, ''), '(unmapped)') END AS neighborhood,
       count(*) AS listings,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.ppm2)::int AS "median KM/m2"
FROM listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
WHERE room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Neighborhood breakdown — actives
panels.description: District assigned from the ad's map pin (approximate rectangles — db/init/11-neighborhoods.sql). (unmapped) = pin outside every district, usually surrounding settlements.

panels.title: Price vs m² — sales
panels.description: Every sale listing matching the filters as a point (floor area × asking price). The dotted second series traces the least-squares fit computed over the same set — listings clearly below it are the genuine bargains; bottom-left outliers are often studios or data errors.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT l.sqm, l.price AS price_km
FROM listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
WHERE NOT l.is_rent AND l.price IS NOT NULL AND l.ppm2 > 0 AND l.sqm > 0
  AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])

WITH base AS (
  SELECT l.sqm::float8 AS sqm, l.price::float8 AS price
  FROM listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
  WHERE NOT l.is_rent AND l.price IS NOT NULL AND l.ppm2 > 0 AND l.sqm > 0
    AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
    AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])
),
fit AS (
  SELECT min(sqm) AS x0, max(sqm) AS x1,
         regr_slope(price, sqm) AS s, regr_intercept(price, sqm) AS b
  FROM base
)
SELECT (x0 + (x1 - x0) * gs / 80.0)::float8 AS sqm,
       round(b + s * (x0 + (x1 - x0) * gs / 80.0))::double precision AS price_km
FROM fit, generate_series(0, 80) gs
WHERE s IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Gross yield · rent vs sale
panels.description: Median asking rent × 12 ÷ median asking sale price, within the current filters. An asking-price proxy for cap-rate screening — ignores the Deal filter (needs both sides), not a net return.

targets.rawSql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.price) AS p
  FROM listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
  WHERE NOT l.is_rent AND l.price > 0
    AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
    AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])
),
r AS (
  SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.price) AS p
  FROM listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
  WHERE l.is_rent AND l.price > 0
    AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
    AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])
)
SELECT round((r.p * 12 / s.p * 100)::numeric, 1)::double precision AS gross_yield_pct
FROM s, r

panels.title: Median KM/m² — this week vs last
panels.description: Pooled eligible listing-day asking prices from reconstructed daily inventory, comparing this week with last week. Empty priced populations remain NULL; filters apply to historical category, deal, room, area and neighborhood state.

targets.rawSql:
WITH pooled AS (
  SELECT d.day, d.ppm2
  FROM v_listing_daily d
  WHERE d.price_state = 'valid' AND d.ppm2 IS NOT NULL AND NOT d.is_rent
    AND d.day >= date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - 7
    AND d.day < date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date + 7

  AND (COALESCE(cardinality(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]), 0) = 0
    OR d.category_memberships && ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]
    OR d.category = ANY (ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]))
  AND ('${min_sqm}' = '' OR d.sqm IS NULL OR d.sqm >= NULLIF('${min_sqm}', '')::numeric)
  AND ('${max_sqm}' = '' OR d.sqm IS NULL OR d.sqm <= NULLIF('${max_sqm}', '')::numeric)
  AND (COALESCE(cardinality(ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]), 0) = 0
    OR d.rooms = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
    OR room_bucket(d.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]))
  AND d.deal = ANY (ARRAY(SELECT CASE WHEN selected = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE selected END FROM unnest(ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]) AS t(selected)))
  AND (COALESCE(cardinality(ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]), 0) = 0
    OR d.neighborhood = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}])
    OR d.location = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]))
), weeks AS (
  SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2)
           FILTER (WHERE day >= date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) AS "this wk",
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2)
           FILTER (WHERE day >= date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - 7
                   AND day < date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) AS "last wk"
  FROM pooled
)
SELECT "this wk"::int AS "this wk",
       "last wk"::int AS "last wk",
       round((100.0 * ("this wk" - "last wk") / NULLIF("last wk", 0))::numeric, 1)::double precision AS "Δ %"
FROM weeks

panels.title: Median KM/m² by floor position · sales
panels.description: Asking price by vertical position (ground / mid / top / basement), labels include the sample size n. Detail-page coverage of floor data is still partial (~12 % of actives) — treat as directional until enrichment converges.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN l.floor_num < 0 THEN 'basement'
            WHEN l.floor_num = 0 THEN 'ground'
            WHEN l.floors_total IS NOT NULL AND l.floor_num = l.floors_total THEN 'top'
            ELSE 'mid' END || ' · n=' || count(*)::int AS bucket,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.ppm2)::int AS median_ppm2
FROM listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
WHERE NOT l.is_rent AND l.ppm2 > 0 AND l.floor_num IS NOT NULL
  AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])
GROUP BY CASE WHEN l.floor_num < 0 THEN 'basement'
            WHEN l.floor_num = 0 THEN 'ground'
            WHEN l.floors_total IS NOT NULL AND l.floor_num = l.floors_total THEN 'top'
            ELSE 'mid' END
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Asking KM/m² by seller · sales
panels.description: Private sellers vs agencies ('shop') vs ads where the type wasn't captured. Seller type rides along with every search result, so coverage here is high — one of the biggest price drivers, finally visible.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(l.seller_type, '(unknown)') AS seller,
       count(*)::int AS actives,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.ppm2)::int AS "median KM/m2"
FROM listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
WHERE NOT l.is_rent AND l.ppm2 > 0
  AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Districts ranked — median asking KM/m² · sales
panels.description: Where is it expensive: every district with ≥8 sale listings, ranked by median asking price per m² with the p25–p75 spread. Deliberately ignores the Neighborhood filter (so all districts stay comparable); Category/Rooms/Deal still apply. Districts come from map pins (db/init/11-neighborhoods.sql).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN l.latitude IS NULL THEN '(no pin)'
            ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(l.location, ''), '(unmapped)') END AS district,
       count(*)::int AS actives,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.ppm2)::int AS "median KM/m2",
       percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.ppm2)::int AS p25,
       percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.ppm2)::int AS p75
FROM listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[]::text[]) l
WHERE NOT l.is_rent AND l.ppm2 > 0
  AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])
GROUP BY 1
HAVING count(*) >= 8
ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST

list.definition: SELECT category AS __value, category AS __text FROM (SELECT category FROM saved_searches WHERE category IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT unnest(category_memberships) FROM listing_daily) s WHERE category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category ORDER BY 1
list.label: Category
list.name: category
list.query: SELECT category AS __value, category AS __text FROM (SELECT category FROM saved_searches WHERE category IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT unnest(category_memberships) FROM listing_daily) s WHERE category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category ORDER BY 1

list.definition: SELECT bucket AS __value, bucket AS __text FROM (SELECT room_bucket(rooms) AS bucket FROM v_active_listings UNION SELECT room_bucket(rooms) FROM v_listing_daily WHERE rooms IS NOT NULL) s WHERE bucket IS NOT NULL GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY 1
list.label: Rooms
list.name: rooms
list.query: SELECT bucket AS __value, bucket AS __text FROM (SELECT room_bucket(rooms) AS bucket FROM v_active_listings UNION SELECT room_bucket(rooms) FROM v_listing_daily WHERE rooms IS NOT NULL) s WHERE bucket IS NOT NULL GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY 1

list.definition: SELECT neighborhood AS __value, neighborhood AS __text FROM (SELECT neighborhood FROM v_listing_daily WHERE neighborhood IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT location FROM v_listing_daily WHERE location IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(location, ''), CASE WHEN latitude IS NULL THEN '(no pin)' ELSE '(unmapped)' END) FROM listings UNION SELECT '(no pin)' UNION SELECT '(unmapped)') s GROUP BY neighborhood ORDER BY 1
list.label: Neighborhood
list.name: neighborhood
list.query: SELECT neighborhood AS __value, neighborhood AS __text FROM (SELECT neighborhood FROM v_listing_daily WHERE neighborhood IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT location FROM v_listing_daily WHERE location IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(location, ''), CASE WHEN latitude IS NULL THEN '(no pin)' ELSE '(unmapped)' END) FROM listings UNION SELECT '(no pin)' UNION SELECT '(unmapped)') s GROUP BY neighborhood ORDER BY 1

title: OLX.ba Market Overview
